answer:
Based on the search results, **President Barack Obama** was the American president who entered into the Paris Agreement. He made the United States a signatory to the agreement in April 2016 and formally accepted it through executive order in September 2016. 

Barack Obama was a member of the **Democratic Party**.

Note: Later, President Joe Biden (also a Democrat) formally re-entered the Paris Agreement on February 19, 2021, after President Donald Trump (Republican) had withdrawn from it in 2020. However, Obama's 2016 action represents when the United States first joined the Paris Agreement.
